title: Noodles before the New Year
story: On the night before the new year, Kenji and his grandmother made long noodles. She said the long strands stood for a long life. Kenji boiled water and watched the pot so it would not spill. His grandmother added greens, ginger, and a little soy. They set two bowls on a red cloth. Kenji tried to slurp the way she did and laughed when a strand hit his chin. She told him to slow down and taste the ginger. Neighbours knocked later and shared oranges. Kenji packed a small box of noodles for his teacher. The meal was simple, but the story in it was old.
